items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: I don't know if Bradley...Bradley was a foot patrolman or something at the time in Los Angeles or something... But Alton Redd, the drummer, knew Bradley real well in the later years; I know that, because they was friends.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, that's the next step. Tell me about that.

From the taxi dances, they had a woman named Freida Shaw that... For years she had singing choruses that sing in the movies for different background stuff and everything. And she was offered the job... And she played a little drums and she was a vocalist. So she offered the job to Big Boy and I, this tenor-man and myself. Because they wanted five pieces, I believe... Anyway, Big Boy didn't want to go. And at that very same time that all of this was happening, the Elks was organizing a band to go to Chicago at the…
